metadata.name: Secure File Handling & PDF Processing Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Comprehensive file handling, PDF processing, and document safety system preventing malware, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

fileType.verification:
1. Check file extension (.pdf)
2. Verify MIME type: application/pdf
3. Check PDF magic bytes: %PDF-1.x at file start
fileType.implementation: Magic number check > file extension check > MIME type check

fileSize.enforcement: Reject uploads exceeding limits with clear error message

malware.timing: Scan immediately after upload, before storage
malware.action: Quarantine infected files; do not make accessible

embedded.check: Scan for embedded malicious content (JavaScript, Flash, etc.)
embedded.implementation: PDFoid or similar PDF analysis tool
embedded.removal: Remove potentially malicious elements before storing

storage.location: Cloud object storage (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob)
storage.encryption: AES-256 encryption at rest (handled by encryption core)
storage.access: Private by default; requires authentication to access
storage.versioning: Keep file versions for 30 days (enable in S3/GCS versioning)

tempFiles.creation: Only in encrypted temp directory (/tmp with encryption)
tempFiles.cleanup: Cryptographic erasure (overwrite 3x before deletion) or OS secure deletion
tempFiles.monitoring: Alert if temp files accumulate (stale files)

pdfParsing.library: PyPDF2, pdfplumber, or pikepdf (avoid older libraries with known vulnerabilities)

safety.noExecute: Never execute embedded scripts or JavaScript in PDFs
safety.sandboxing: Process PDFs in sandboxed environment (Docker container or VM)
safety.timeout: Kill processing after 30 seconds (prevents DoS via complex PDFs)
safety.memoryLimit: Limit memory to 2GB per PDF processing (prevent OOM attacks)

textExtraction.fallback: If text extraction fails, use OCR (Tesseract)
textExtraction.validation: Verify extracted text doesn't contain suspicious patterns

dataExtraction.llmUsage: Claude API for intelligent data extraction from unstructured text
dataExtraction.piiHandling: Extracted PII (SSN, DOB, addresses) immediately encrypted before storage
dataExtraction.validation: Validate extracted data against expected patterns (e.g., SSN = 9 digits)

tableExtraction.method: pdfplumber for table extraction or camelot
tableExtraction.format: Convert to structured JSON/CSV for easier processing

extraction.errorHandling: If extraction fails, mark document as 'requires manual review'

imageExtraction.method: Extract images from PDFs for signature verification or OCR

libraries: ReportLab (Python): Low-level PDF generation, high control
WeasyPrint: HTML to PDF conversion (recommended for complex layouts)
Puppeteer (Node.js): Chrome automation for HTML to PDF

security.noExecution: Generated PDFs contain NO executable content
security.noRedirect: No external URL references that could trigger downloads
security.fontEmbedding: Embed fonts in PDF to prevent substitution attacks

workflow.step1: Generate PDF from template using safe library
workflow.step3: Sign PDF digitally if required (using private key in HSM)
workflow.step6: Return encrypted file reference (not file itself) to user

digitalSignature.requirement: PDFs can be digitally signed to prove authenticity and non-repudiation

implementation.method: PKCS#7 or PAdES (PDF Advanced Electronic Signatures)
implementation.certificate: Use certificate from trusted CA (DigiCert, Sectigo, etc.)
implementation.storage: Private key stored in HSM, never accessible to application
implementation.signatureTimestamp: Include timestamp from trusted TSA (Time Stamp Authority)

verification.requirement: Recipient can verify signature is valid and certificate chain is trusted
verification.validation: PDF reader (Adobe, Foxit) validates signature cryptographically

downloadSecurity.requirement: When users download their PDF, ensure secure delivery

implementation.step1: Verify user is authenticated and authorized to download file
implementation.step2: Log download event (WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHERE)
implementation.step4: Set proper HTTP headers to prevent caching/interception

prevention.noCloudSync: PDFs never synced to personal cloud (Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.)
prevention.noScreenshots: Optional: Disable screenshots in secure viewer
prevention.watermarking: Optional: Add visible/invisible watermark with user ID and timestamp

policyDefault.activeDocuments: Retained while user has active account
policyDefault.deletedDocuments: Soft-delete for 30 days, then hard-delete (cryptographic erasure)

retention.userControl: Users can manually delete documents immediately (hard-delete after 24-hour grace period)

requirements.name: malware-detection
requirements.test: Verify malicious PDFs are detected and rejected
requirements.method: Upload EICAR test file (scanner test file); verify rejected

requirements.name: authorization
requirements.test: Verify User A cannot download User B's PDF
requirements.method: User A attempts to download User B's file ID; verify 403 Forbidden

requirements.name: extraction-safety
requirements.test: Verify PDF extraction doesn't execute embedded scripts
requirements.method: Process PDF with embedded JavaScript; verify no execution

requirements.name: encryption
requirements.method: Read raw file from storage; verify not valid PDF (unreadable)

libraries: PDF Processing: PyPDF2, pdfplumber, pikepdf, camelot
